positions.title: Senior Web Developer
positions.description:
Foundation Team
- The Foundation Team is a small scrum team that focuses on products to enable other teams with modernization of HealthPartners backend systems.

- Worked to get all of our projects into Continuous Integration / Continuous Delivery; every merge to our Master branch will get deployed to all environments, including production.

- Used tools such as SonarQube and HP Fortify to ensure code quality and that security requirements have been met.

- Mentored other developers and often pair programmed to make sure that we meet our sprint goals.

- Evangelized Test Driven Development and CI/CD to other teammates and teams.

- Provided technical guidance on our two core products:

-- Change Data Capture (CDC)
--- The CDC application consists of five microservices running on our internal OpenShift platform.
--- Deployed Kafka to our internal OpenShift platform.
--- Technology Used: OpenShift/Kubernetes, Kafka, Kafka Streams, Java 8, Spring Boot, Docker

-- Single Sign On
--- The configuration of Red Hat SSO is completely scripted; configuration as code.
--- Worked with other teams to implement our Single Sign Solution.
--- Technology Used: OpenShift/Kubernetes, Red Hat SSO/Keycloak, Python, Spring Boot, ReactJS, Docker

Authenticated Experience Team
 - As a core member of the Authenticated Experience team I worked on several enhancements on the authenticated HealthPartners.com.

- Worked as the Technical Lead on a project with OptumBank to provide Health Savings Account data on HealthPartners.com.

- Lead a project to convert ‘Coordination of Benefits’ forms from paper to online. This project made extensive use of ReactJS components.

- Worked closely with User Experience team members to ensure that our website was mobile friendly and met accessibility requirements.

- Mentored other full-stack and front-end developers.

Technology Used: Java 8, Spring Boot, ReactJS, AngularJS, Spring MVC, REST,  SOAP, Oracle Database, MongoDB

positions.title: Senior Business Technical Analyst-Java Developer
positions.description:
Managed the technical relationship with implementation partner for the new Product Search application.

Created a suite RESTful web services to provide product data (product attributes, inventory and customer pricing information) from the Oracle ERP systems to the Product Search application.

Worked with other teams to create environments for the new Product Search application, which included the full suite of Oracle Commerce (ATG, Endeca, BCC, etc.).

After the successful implementation of the Product Search application, I became sole developer for enhancements and bug fixing for both the customer facing site and the Product Information Management system.

Support and enhancements of other applications our team is responsible for.

positions.title: Lead Systems Developer
positions.description:
Key team member on a large project to build an internal web application allowing our business users to create and maintain contracts between our clients and pharmaceutical vendors. 

Effectively manage multiple priorities as part of the Scrum Team; directly responsible for designing, coding and unit testing components of the application, as well as participating in code walkthroughs.

Display strong leadership traits while mentoring new members to the team, as well as being paired with other team members to provide guidance on an as-needed basis.

Consistently deliver all project elements on time, within projected budget and adhering to all project specifications. 

Continuously maintained and updated the member facing websites (MyPrime.com and MyPrimeMail.com), a mobile version of the websites and a suite of web services.

Successfully implemented new features for our production website on a quarterly release schedule; assisted our Systems Analysts in updating the static content, when needed.

Exceeded expectations for performance in the role of Technical Team Leader which included assigning work to other developers, collaborating with Project Managers to ensure on-time releases, interacting with System Analysts to obtain requirements and supporting QA with defect resolution.

positions.title: Senior Java Applications Engineer
positions.description:
Excelled as Senior Developer, working on many applications that support HIPAA transactions; patient eligibility and claim status request. Development and Support project highlights are as follows:

Lead Developer on the 27xInsertService, a J2EE application that listens to an MQ Queue, then inserts the message into Oracle 8i database for historical auditing purposes. When a message is received the application parses the message, which is in EDI format, to build a unique key based on some of the content in the message, then wraps the EDI in an XML document and inserts it into the database. If any error happens during the transaction, the application will send out a page using Tivoli Notification Manager. This application was processing approximately 120,000 messages a day.

Supported HTX (HIPAA Transaction Processor, another J2EE application). HTX is called from several other applications, including real-time web applications and batch applications. As input, it can receive XML, EDI or a Java Bean and will return an XML document containing ‘benefit’ or ‘claim’ status information as the response. This application is running on Weblogic 8.1 and uses a custom shared component library to connect to Oracle and DB2 data sources.

Supported application that provides a web front-end to manually fix claims for processing. This application allows users to fix errors in EDI documents that were received from providers, which did not pass Pre-Adjudication. It runs on Weblogic 8.1 and is connected to an Oracle database. For the presentation layer the application uses the Struts framework and JSP.

company.name: Blue Cross and Blue Shield of Minnesota

positions.title: Senior Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
Critical team member within a small group of highly skilled developers and architects, designing, developing and unit testing new feature development for a J2EE application that does financial reconciliation and collaboration. The product was sold to Fortune 50 companies.

Successfully deployed application to Weblogic and Websphere application servers. Utilizing Hibernate-3.0 as the ORM layer, the application seamlessly communicated with either an Oracle or DB2 data source. The presentation layer uses WebWork2 and JSP.

Designed and created an ‘Administration’ section of the application using WebWork2, allowing users to maintain look-up data. The project was used as a successful proof-of-concept for using Webwork2.

positions.title: Senior Web Applications Developer
positions.description:
Directly responsible for the maintenance and new feature development for the HealthForums.com product that lets consumers search and obtain health related content. HealthForums.com is a multi-tiered application using Java, JSP, Servlets, StoryServer, CORBA, DB2, and Sybase running on Solaris and AIX.

HealthForums.com also supplied content to another web based application, myUHC.com, an application that allows members to view their medical claims, purchase prescription drugs and obtain health related content. We utilized MQSeries, Java, JSP, Servlets, StoryServer, and Sybase to provide our content to myUHC.com.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
One of four engineers who built the architecture for a web-based recruiting application developed with Java, JSP, Servlets, CORBA and Oracle running on Solaris.

Wrote extensive amounts of JSP and Java, using JDBC to connect to the Oracle 8i database.

Technical Team Lead for the Employer Administration site rewrite. We developed the application using a full object oriented analysis and design process.

Served as a liaison to business development, working with them to further refine their ideas and help translate them into viable technical solutions.
